There is something you guys should know
This place.... X city, isn't in the same dimension as home
but that dimension, the one you guys call home, isn't actually my home.
You see, this dimension is my real home
I was somehow transported to the world where you guys are from when I was around 10 years old
It's where I learned how to blade, and i made a lot of friends
But I never stopped trying to find a way back
I believed that the answer was somehow connected to beyblade, as blading felt like home for me
I finally figured it out, and returned to this world, my home
However, once I came here, I found that I wasn't able to go back
Its why I "disappeared"
From what I've gathered, your home dimension is on the brink of destruction
I believe that everyone else was scattered throughout this realm.
Anyways, I told you it was a long story
Oh, I almost forgot about that.
So, in this world, the blading system is rather different from what y'all are used to
People blade in teams of 3 people, and aim for the top of the X together
And in order to be qualified to do this, you need a bey sponsor
A bey sponsor will provide teams with means to train, beycraft, etc
In return, the sponsor will benefit from the popularity brought by the team they sponsor.
And I would be more than happy to be your sponsor
I would if I could, but I can't.
However, I think I have the perfect person for the job
Whoa whoa whoa! Why doesn't he answer those things with a battle.
Now then...
I believe that this team is worthy to conquer the X!!!
Hi, my name is Keigo Ishiyama
